categories.main_business_segments: Dongyue Group Limited operates primarily in the fluorosilicon chemical industry with key segments including Polymers (fluoropolymers), Organic Silicon, Refrigerants, Dichloromethane and Liquid Alkali, and Other operations which include by-products, property development, and rental income. These segments focus on manufacturing, distribution, and sales of chemical products and related materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group utilizes advanced fluorosilicon chemical technologies including production of fluoropolymers like PTFE, FEP, FKM, PVDF, and refrigerants such as R22, R32, R125, and R410a. It employs pilot-scale production trials, new technology and process developments, and has a comprehensive QHSE management system integrating quality, occupational health and safety, environment, and energy management. The Group also emphasizes informatization in quality and process alarm management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dongyue serves customers in chemical, construction, electrical and electronics, automotive, aviation, semiconductor, biomedical, green environmental protection, and catalyst industries. Its refrigerants are widely used in air conditioning and automotive cooling systems. The Group's products are recognized in domestic high-end markets and are supplied to leading domestic power battery manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations and major assets are primarily located in Mainland China, with over 95% of non-current assets situated there. It also serves customers in Asia (excluding China), America, Europe, Africa, and Oceania. The Group has subsidiaries and joint ventures across various regions in China and engages in international trade.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongyue operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the fluorosilicon chemical supply chain, producing key raw materials like R22 internally for downstream fluoropolymer production. It also manages upstream intermediates such as DMC for organic silicon products and maintains a comprehensive supplier management system covering the entire supplier lifecycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes R&D as a core competitive advantage, investing approximately RMB707 million in over 40 R&D projects annually. It focuses on market-driven innovation, expanding product applications, and strengthening the fluorosilicon chemical industry chain. Key R&D areas include new energy, environmental protection, new materials, and high-end product development such as PVDF membranes and lithium-ion battery materials. The Group also actively protects intellectual property and promotes industry standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of chemical products including polymers, organic silicon, refrigerants, dichloromethane, and liquid alkali. The Group also earns income from by-products, property development, and rental income. Sales are recognized at the point when control of goods is transferred to customers, with inter-segment sales charged at prevailing market rates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Dongyue Group positions itself as a market leader in China’s high-end fluorosilicon chemical segment, leveraging superior technology, product quality, and strategic layout in high-end products to maintain competitive advantages amid intense market competition and price fluctuations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB14.18 billion, a slight decrease of 2.15% from the previous year. Profit before tax nearly doubled to RMB1.42 billion, with net profit reaching RMB987 million. The Group maintains strong financial health with total equity of RMB17.47 billion, no borrowings, and positive net cash position. Capital expenditures were about RMB1.8 billion, mainly for production line upgrades and facility construction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongyue emphasizes superior product quality, advanced technology, and cost management to maintain high product selling prices and profitability. It focuses on innovation, high-end product offerings, and stable production to enhance competitiveness. The Group also integrates ESG principles, sustainable development, and strong corporate governance to create long-term value for stakeholders.
